roles.title: 01 Read the signed terms
roles.objective: Identify the coefficient and the added constant in an ordered pair.
roles.prerequisites: Multiplication notation; signed numbers; order in a pair.

roles.title: 02 Remove a negative constant
roles.objective: Evaluate the right side after removing a negative added constant.
roles.prerequisites: Addition of integers; inverse operations on both sides.

roles.title: 03 Choose a useful balanced move
roles.objective: Remove the added constant while preserving the coefficient and the solution set.
roles.prerequisites: Equality; signed coefficients; subtracting on both sides.

roles.title: 04 Explain the inverse
roles.objective: Choose the inverse that recovers the equation before division.
roles.prerequisites: Nonzero multiplication and division; inverse operations.

roles.title: 05 Find and repair the first error
roles.objective: Identify the first invalid transformation and repair its right side.
roles.prerequisites: Signed added constants; evaluation; reading sequential lines.

roles.title: 06 Solve a fresh equation
roles.objective: Select the exact value that satisfies the original equality.
roles.prerequisites: Equality in either orientation; balanced operations; exact fractions.
